premiumPreview.summary: Design global live comments with resumable ordering, moderation revisions, readable follow mode, and burst-safe rendering without client-side event loss.
learningOutcomes: Merge snapshots, comment events, and moderation updates by identity and sequence.
Preserve a reader's anchor while new comments accumulate at the live edge.
Bound rendered rows and retained bodies without inventing a client drop policy.
Reconcile optimistic comments, reconnect gaps, tombstones, and accessible announcements.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the gap-repair example, moderation revisions, follow-mode trade-offs, and burst recovery analysis.
